Ashwin questions Kuldeep Yadav's repeated omission from ODI team

Cricketer Ravichandran Ashwin has voiced concern over the repeated exclusion of fellow spinner Kuldeep Yadav from the Indian ODI team. Ashwin stated that such consistent snubs could negatively impact Yadav's confidence and rhythm. Yadav was again left out for the third ODI against England, with India opting for a pace-heavy attack.
